economic_hypothesis: A continuously traded stock that remains inside a bounded sixty-session inventory range, tightens further during the last twenty sessions, and experiences declining five-session turnover has limited immediately available supply. A non-limit, high-location, volume-expansion close above the entire prior sixty-session range is a causal price-discovery event rather than a policy-locked limit move.

causal_state.continuous_history: 60 preceding symbol rows exist; at least 55 are hard-valid, current-valid and tradable.
causal_state.broad_inventory_range: minimum coordinate low / maximum coordinate high over the preceding 60 completed symbol rows is >=65%.
causal_state.recent_compression: minimum coordinate low / maximum coordinate high over the preceding 20 completed symbol rows is >=85%.
causal_state.supply_contraction: mean turnover over the preceding 5 completed rows is <= mean turnover over the preceding 20 completed rows.

trigger.return: signal-session step return is between +4% and +12%, inclusive.
trigger.new_price_discovery: completed coordinate close is strictly above the maximum coordinate high of the preceding 60 completed symbol rows.
trigger.volume_expansion: signal-session turnover is >=1.5 times preceding-20-session mean turnover.
trigger.high_location: signal close location within its range is >=75%; a zero-range bar is 100%.
trigger.not_limit_up: signal coordinate close is strictly below the legal upper-limit coordinate.
trigger.deduplication: consecutive qualifying events no more than 20 market-session indices apart form one event cluster; retain its first event only.

entry: next legal executable session open, with no signal-bar fill
profile_selection: Using 2014-2018 only, maximize median annual mean net return, then pooled mean net return, then prefer the shorter horizon.
confirmation: Evaluate only the selected profile on 2019, 2020 and 2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net return >3%, positive pooled median, and positive mean net return in each confirmation year.
